provenance.coverage: Deterministic required-facts checklist: closed-vocabulary decision, exact key set of rejected options, exact eliminating-constraint set per rejected option (7 rows incl. the plausible-but-wrong built-in custom provider and two 5-step boundary cases), recomputed costs within one cent, honest nulls and an exact unknowns set, repo-derived function sets, and required citations to source IDs. No model judge.
provenance.derivation: Private decision record (PR #20, issue #19): the admin password of a static-web-app + serverless-functions media vault was a plaintext env var compared in several functions; five auth options (platform built-in auth with the pre-configured GitHub provider, the cloud provider's consumer-identity tenant, two identity SaaS vendors, a self-hosted OIDC server) were evaluated on cost, complexity, guest UX, admin UX, roles and session handling, and built-in GitHub sign-in was selected. Re-synthesized as seven sanitized sources: neutral paraphrases of the platform/vendor facts the decision relied on (vendor and product names generalized), a requirements sheet that turns the record's criteria into seven explicit hard constraints, and repo excerpts reduced from the base commit (functions that read the password: adminAuth, generateJoinToken, getAuditLog; admin functions with no check: manageAlbum and the library-sync function, renamed). Added beyond the record to make the decision uniquely determined and discriminating: two plausible platform-native traps that need the paid plan (custom OIDC provider, site-wide password protection), a hardened-password option, numbered setup-step lists with two options exactly at the 5-step limit, a two-app deployment so plan costs double, and a vendor whose price the sources omit (honest null). The plan price, app count, step counts and MAU limits are invented. No private code, hostnames, domains or personal data are included.
provenance.historical_exposure: Private history; generalized vendor names and invented quantities give low recognition risk.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
